name: glance-editor
description: Your Glance dashboard and a no-code editor for it, in one container. Build pages, columns and widgets, pick a theme, icons and a background image, all in the browser, without writing YAML. See your changes in Preview before you save; every save is checked by Glance first and kept in History, so you can go back to any earlier version. Includes Glance (github.com/glanceapp/glance) at the version the editor is tested with. Open the editor from WebUI; your dashboard is on the Dashboard port. No login: keep it on your LAN.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Everything in one folder: config/glance.yml (your dashboard), assets/ (icons and backgrounds), editor/ (every saved version and the settings). Include it in your backups.

paths.name: Docker socket (read only)
paths.description: For the Docker containers widget, and so the editor can list your containers to show or hide them. The editor itself never gets the socket: it can only list containers. Remove this if you don't need it.

paths.name: Photos (optional)
paths.description: A folder of your own photos to use as backgrounds, read only.

ports.name: Dashboard
ports.description: Your Glance dashboard. Use another port if something else, like your current Glance, already uses this one.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user the editor runs as and writes files as (Unraid: nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group the editor writes files as (Unraid: users).
